Title: Alphabet (GOOGL) 2026Q3 Earnings Preview -- Historical Reconstruction

This preview is a historical reconstruction. It uses only the Alphabet Q2 2026 earnings release published on July 22, 2026. It was not written before the Q3 earnings date.

Baseline from Q2 2026:
- Alphabet reported total revenue of $119.8 billion. Revenue grew 24% year over year, or 23% in constant currency.
- Google Services revenue was $94.5 billion, up 15%. Google Search & other grew 17% to $63.3 billion. YouTube ads grew 13% to $11.1 billion. Google Network fell slightly to $7.3 billion.
- Google Cloud revenue was $24.8 billion, up 82%. Cloud operating income was $8.8 billion. The implied segment operating margin was about 36%.
- Total operating income was $40.8 billion. Operating margin was 34%.
- Other income included a net gain of $98.0 billion, mainly from unrealized equity securities. Net income available to common stockholders was $112.1 billion. Diluted EPS was $9.11.
- In June, Alphabet raised $49.6 billion through equity and mandatory convertible preferred stock. It also issued $20.3 billion of senior notes. It established a $40.0 billion ATM program. No ATM shares had been sold by June 30, 2026.

Core questions for Q3 2026:
1. Can Google Cloud sustain its 82% revenue growth? High growth may continue or moderate. Watch the segment operating margin.
2. Will new financing and AI infrastructure spending reduce operating margin? Revenue growth may offset some pressure.
3. The $98.0 billion non-operating gain is not repeatable. How much of Q3 EPS will come from operations?

Potential upside signals:
- Search grew 17% in Q2. The CEO says AI features drive Search query growth.
- Gemini Enterprise is used by nearly 90% of the Fortune 100. Gemini App has 950 million monthly active users. Gemini models process 22 billion API tokens per minute.
- Cloud revenue accelerated to 82% growth in Q2. Demand for AI infrastructure and AI solutions is strong.

Potential downside risks:
- Google Network declined slightly in Q2.
- Aggregate revenue faces a high comparison base.
- Unrealized investment gains are not repeatable. EPS may be noisy.
- New shares and preferred stock will increase dilution.
- Other Bets losses widened from $1.2 billion to $1.8 billion.

Verification points for the Q3 2026 release:
- Google Cloud revenue growth and segment operating margin.
- Total operating margin and Alphabet-level AI research costs.
- Search, YouTube ads, and Google Network growth rates.
- Diluted weighted average share count and EPS excluding non-operating gains.
- TAC as a percentage of advertising revenue.
- Capital expenditures, depreciation, and any new financing.

This draft includes no market consensus or analyst estimates.
reader_questions: Q2 净利润与 EPS 的暴增主要来自 980 亿美元未实现股权证券收益；Q3 若该收益消失或回拨，市场是否会将 EPS 下滑误读为基本面恶化？
6 月发行的 496 亿美元中包括强制可转换优先股；其转换或摊薄条款会如何影响 Q3 及之后的普通股股东可分配利润和每股指标？
Google Cloud 约 35.6% 的分部营业利润率是在 82% 高增速下达到的；新一轮 AI 基础设施资本开支的折旧是否会压缩该利润率，还是高毛利 AI 解决方案占比提升会继续推高利润率？
fact_checks: 确认来源日期为 2026-07-22，财季为截至 2026-06-30 的 2026Q2；本目标为 2026Q3，截至 cutoff 前没有 Q3 财报信息。
确认合并数据：收入 119,796 百万美元，同比 +24%，经汇率 +23%；经营利润 40,770 百万美元，经营利润率 34%；币种均为美元、GAAP 口径。
确认分部收入：Google Services 94,540、Search & other 63,271、YouTube ads 11,055、Google Network 7,303、subs/platforms/devices 12,911、Google Cloud 24,768、Other Bets 382、Hedging 106（单位：百万美元）。
确认分部营业利润：Google Services 39,544；Google Cloud 8,814；Other Bets -1,799；Alphabet-level activities -5,789；合计 40,770。Cloud 营业利润率 ≈35.6% 为本稿计算值，非公司披露。
确认净利与 EPS：其他收入净项 97,983；净利 112,107；摊薄 EPS 9.11；同比 +298%/+294%。
确认资本结构：6 月股权及强制可转换优先股净融资 49.6B；高级无担保票据 20.3B；ATM 计划 40.0B，截至 6/30 未售任何股份；普通股季度股息 0.22 美元/股。
确认其他运营数据：TAC 16,179 百万美元；员工 198,933；本稿未引用任何未披露的产品利润数字。
确认所有 Q3 情景均为基于 Q2 财报数据的推论而非公司指引；没有使用 2026Q3 财报后的信息或外部共识数据。
